work_unit.title: 让工作台绑定真实活跃 DeploymentRevision
work_unit.goal: 用受版本治理的活跃 DeploymentRevision 选择器替代误导性的 Agent UUID 文本框，使 UI 创建的 GraphRevision 满足领域合同。

reason: 真实 Web Chat Target 在工作台输入兼容 Agent ID 后被 Go Domain API 以 DEPLOYMENT_REVISION_NOT_ACTIVE 拒绝。领域合同明确要求 AgentTask 绑定活跃 DeploymentRevision。

rules: List only active DeploymentRevision facts from active deployments in the same Workspace.
Send the selected DeploymentRevision ID as both AgentTask responsible principal and Run actor identity.
Do not weaken the Go validation or fall back to compatibility Agent IDs.

commands: browser real Target GraphRevision create and activate
